content.title: Gilgeous-Alexander, Oklahoma City dominate Phoenix Suns in Game 1 win
content.text: Updated April 19, 2026, 6:58 p.m. MTPhoenix committed 34 turnovers, which led to 19 points for Oklahoma City.The Suns played without Mark Williams and Jordan Goodwin, who both left the game with injuries.OKLAHOMA CITY — The Phoenix Suns began the 2026 NBA playoffs Sunday, April 19, with a lopsided 119-84 loss to the defending NBA champion Oklahoma City Thunder before a sellout crowd of 18,203 at Paycom Center.The Suns trailed Game 1 of this best-of-7 first-round series by as many as 39 points.Thunder All-Star Shai Gilgeous-Alexander finished with 25 points in leading the top overall seed in the playoffs. Jalen Williams added 22.Devin Booker paced the Suns with 23 points. Oklahoma City scored 19 points off 34 Phoenix turnovers.Phoenix scored only two points off just eight Oklahoma City turnovers.The Thunder went 3-2 against Phoenix in the regular season.The Suns were without Mark Williams (left foot soreness), and Grayson Allen (left hamstring strain) didn't play despite being available.Game 2 is Wednesday, April 22, in Oklahoma City. 3rd Q: Thunder 97, Suns 66Shai Gilgeous-Alexander has 25 points in leading Oklahoma City to a 97-66 lead going into the fourth quarter.The reigning MVP is 15-of-17 from the line. He scored 10 of his 25 points in the third quarter.Jalen Williams has 18 points and Chet Holmgren stands at 16 points.Devin Booker has a team-high 23 points. The Suns are 10-of-32 from 3Jordan Goodwin left the game with left calf soreness midway through the second quarter and didn't return. He scored just two points in five minutes.Oklahoma City has 29 points off 14 Phoenix turnovers. Half: Thunder 65, Suns 44The Oklahoma City Thunder continue to dominate in building a 65-44 halftime lead.The Thunder led by as many as 25 in the first half. Nine different OKC players have scored.Chet Holmgren, Shai Gilgeous-Alexander and Jalen Williams combined for 42 points.The Suns have allowed 21 points off 10 turnovers.Devin Booker has a team-high 13 points. Dillon Brooks is at 12 points and Jalen Green has added 10.The rest of the Suns have scored just nine points. Phoenix is shooting 30.4% from the field, going 7-of-24 from 3. 1st Q: Thunder 35, Suns 20The Oklahoma City Thunder went on a 17-2 run in taking a 35-20 lead to end the first quarter.Thunder All-Star forward Chet Holmgren has a game-high 13 points and six rebounds to lead the Thunder as he hit a 3 at the buzzer.The Suns committed four turnovers in the first quarter that led to eight Oklahoma City points.Phoenix is shooting just 33.3% from the field, going 3-of-12 from 3. Devin Booker has a team-high eight points.Williams out, Allen inThe Phoenix Suns will be without Mark Williams for a second straight game with what the team is describing as left foot soreness. The 7-footer missed 15 consecutive games with left foot third metatarsal stress reaction.Grayson Allen is available to play after being listed as questionable with a left hamstring strain. He was available for the play-in win over Golden State, but didn't play."Just all hands on deck," said Suns coach Jordan Ott pregame. "You never know the situation that could come up. He's been through the wars. He can hop in there end of game, end of quarter. Some situations that we would need him. So he was ready to go."The Suns will start Devin Booker, Jalen Green, Jordan Goodwin, Dillon Brooks and Oso Ighodaro in place of Williams.The Thunder are starting Lu Dort, Shai Gilgeous-Alexander, Jalen Williams, Chet Holmgren and Isaiah Hartenstein.Have opinions about the current state of the Suns?
